column1: H3-ORR1H3-CRD1The Observable Representation shall preserve whether a braking-relevant obstacle condition is present in the operational situation.BrakingRelevantObstaclePresent_R(x) != BrakingRelevantObstaclePresent_R(y) for situations separated by H3-CRD1.H-3;FR-7;FR-7.2;FR-7.2.1Without this distinction the representation cannot support evaluation of whether an obstacle-based justification for braking exists.

H3-ORR2H3-CRD2The Observable Representation shall preserve whether the spatial relation between the ego vehicle and an obstacle falls in a condition that justifies braking or one that does not.BrakingJustifyingDistanceClass_R(x) != BrakingJustifyingDistanceClass_R(y) for situations separated by H3-CRD2.H-3;FR-7.1;FR-7.2.4Distance is relevant to braking justification, but the dangerous-zone boundary is tbd; therefore no numerical threshold is introduced by RAISE2.
